  region = "us-west-2"
}

  name           = "DatabaseCache"
  billing_mode   = "PROVISIONED"
  read_capacity  = 20

  hash_key       = "UserId"

  - **Global Secondary Index**: A secondary index named `GameTitleIndex` is created to improve query performance on the `GameTitle` attribute.

}

resource "aws_vpc" "main_vpc" {

  enable_dns_support   = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
}

  cidr_block        = "10.0.1.0/24"

  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
}

  name        = "database_access_sg"

}
